title: A batch gate with no verified run gets 1.5 times its catalog time
description: Runs the gate over a 55-minute recorded catalog with no verified run: a 60-minute run is inside the 82.5-minute bound, verifies and becomes the first sample instead of timing out at 45 minutes (GY-3523).

steps.name: a gate longer than 45 minutes and shorter than 1.5 times its catalog verifies
